sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1'), f AS (SELECT f.market_ticker, f.action, f.price, f.quantity FROM fills f JOIN t USING (market_ticker)), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl FROM positions JOIN t USING (market_ticker) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT 'resting_now' k, count(*)::text a, round(sum(limit_price*quantity)/100.0,2)::text b FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND status='resting' UNION ALL SELECT 'fills_buy', count(*)::text, round(sum(price*quantity)/100.0,2)::text FROM f WHERE action='buy' UNION ALL SELECT 'fills_sell', count(*)::text, round(sum(price*quantity)/100.0,2)::text FROM f WHERE action='sell' UNION ALL SELECT 'realized_pnl_sum', count(*)::text, round(sum(realized_pnl)::numeric,2)::text FROM p UNION ALL SELECT 'open_positions', count(*)::text, string_agg(market_ticker||':'||quantity, ' | ') FROM p WHERE quantity<>0
